name: Hammerhead High
source:
You're a transfer student to Hammerhead High. Can you find love in a crowd full of strangers!?

[From [url=http://lovejam2014.tumblr.com/post/103438529678/game-hammerhead-high]Tumblr[/url]]

A satirical game about dating sharks, created for [url=http://lovejam2014.tumblr.com/]USC MEGA's Love Jam 2014[/url].
translation:
你是Hammerhead高中转学生。能在陌生人组成的人群中找到爱情吗！？

[译自[url=http://lovejam2014.tumblr.com/post/103438529678/game-hammerhead-high]Tumblr[/url]]

一款关于与鲨鱼约会的讽刺游戏，为[url=http://lovejam2014.tumblr.com/]USC MEGA Love Jam 2014[/url]制作。
